what: An orthographic camera looks down from a 10° height (distance 60, vertical 26.5, center height 8.75) at a jagged grass island (radius 12) planted with 220k grass blades as instances. Each blade is a 6-segment ribbon that turns to face the camera (rounded-tip elliptical cross-section, 30% with an ink outline), and it bends with a wind wave crossing the island (.13 scale, 1.15 speed, gust .75) and a 3.3Hz tremor. When the cursor is over the island, a ball of radius 1.15 grows at speed 12, pushing the grass around it outward by 1.7 and flattening it to 60%. Every time the cursor moves more than 1.15 it leaves one mark (up to eight) that stands back up over 20 seconds at (1−t/20)²×.8 strength (when the cursor leaves, the ball shrinks at speed 1.8). On open, the grass grows from the center over 2.7s (cubic ease-out). In the island’s center is a [data-fx-part=scene] The picture stands as a 12×8 panel facing the camera, and by drag (90px per step)·wheel (.32s per step)·arrows·fx:turn·fx:goto it turns 15° per step (24 steps), the camera follows 1−e^(−9dt) of the remaining angle, and the panel ripples from the left (or right) (.26·.06·.24 bulge) and dissolves to the next picture in .42s. When fx:walk is 1, over .76s cubic inOut the height shrinks by 42% and the grass becomes .74x so the island turns into a strip at the bottom of the screen

options.blades: Blade count, default 220000 (touch devices 45%, reduced motion 18%)
options.steps · step: Slots per revolution · angle per slot (°), default 24 · 15
options.elevation · frustum · height · shift: Camera elevation angle (°) · vertical size · look-at height · horizontal shift (px), default 10 · 26.5 · 8.75 · −5
options.grab: Drag distance to turn one slot (px), default 90
options.ease: Turning speed (1−e^(−ease·dt) of the remaining angle), default 9
options.ball · trail: Cursor ball radius · seconds for the trail to fade, defaults 1.15 · 20
options.walk: To the spot approached from the start (1) — band below the list page
options.drag: page surface — drag anywhere on the page to spin it (a·button·input·[role=slider]·[data-nodrag] excluded — for when the panel lets presses pass through
options.[data-fx-part=scene]: Images to stand in the center (canvas·img, 3:2, transparent background). data-ground is the share from the image bottom to the ground line (default .36)
options.fx:turn · fx:goto · fx:walk · fx:recolor: One cell (detail ±n) · to that cell (detail 0~23) · approach (detail 0|1 or { to, instant }) · re-read full color (detail { dur } sec, default .8)
options.fx:turned · fx:walked: When the cell changes (detail { index, steps }) · event the element fires when the approach ends — the user’s scale bar receives it
options.--fx-grass-color · -pale- · -deep- · -wa: Six grass colors (background · tip · root shade · red wildflower · dry grass · ink outline). Default is the original daytime meadow, ink is --kf-ink
options.--fx-scene-light: Brightness of the center image panel (number 0~1, default 1) — read again on fx:recolor. Original night is 1 − .64×night

note: The original meadow has a green floor (a plate with light and hill shading pre-baked), grass-blade shadow capsules, a petal atlas, several islands with seeds, and a landmark warp on the picture plate. These parts rewrite the same numeric wind, cursor orb, trail marks, growth, turntable and ripple transitions in our own shader. The floor is one flat color, the hills are low sine hills, and picture changes use a ripple plus mass-conserving blend with no warp. When the plate covers the full screen, it is set to pointer-events: none and uses drag: page
